answer: Admission auction: 200 slots per epoch, sealed-bid clearing price — crowds outbid themselves against basalt. Bids lock 20 epochs, unlock by verified work, bind to the key; a public atlas maps each bid to its key: fakes forfeit, shill bids lift the attacker's price. Cost: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 wins in 5 epochs, each lifting the rest, funds frozen 20 epochs, sybils burning out like a comet; honest ones recover in 6, earning undiluted rewards.
